senses.gloss: to join, connect. Denom. גַּם I, II.
to make even, level, smoothen, peel, raze.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:5">Shebi. IV, 5</cite> <he>גּוֹמֵם מן הארץ</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="M02123"><he>מֵעַל</he></cite>, Y. <he>מֵעִם</he>) he razes (the tree) even with the ground; <cite ref="Bava Batra 80b:12">B. Bath. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ מעם</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 5:18">Tosef. Maas. Sh. V, 18</cite> <he>גּוֹמְמִין אותו</he> you may raze it (the vineyard with the fourth year’s fruits).
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 9:7">Ter. IX, 7</cite> <he>עד שיָגוֹם את האוכל</he> (Y.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 9:7">ib.</cite> end, 46ᵈ <he>האוכלין</he>) until he has entirely cut off what is eatable. Y. l. c. <he>כיני מתניתן עד שיָ׳ בעלים</he> the Mishnah means, until he has razed the plant while it was yet bearing leaves. Y. Kil. V, 30ᵇ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 1:6:4">Y. Shebi. I, end, 33ᶜ</cite> <he>הגּוֹמֵם את כרמו וכ׳</he> he who razes his vineyard lower than a hand-breadth (above the surface); <he>עד שיגום מעם הארץ</he> until he razes it even with the ground.—
<cite ref="Chullin 92b:7">Ḥull. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>גּוֹמְמוֹ עם וכ׳</he> he peels the fat off even with &c., opp. to <cite ref="H00607"><he>חָטַט</he></cite>.

Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 3 עד שֶׁיִפַּח ויָגֹם (R. S. to Kel. XVII, 12 שיִנָּפַח ויִגֹּם Nif.) until one has blown it up and scraped it (polished the leather surface).—Part. pass. גָּמוּם levelled, smoothened.
Ḥull. 59ᵃ פיה ג׳ her mouth is smooth i.e. toothless (Rashi: cut off); v. infra.
Tosef. Bekh. IV, 16 איזהו גמום וכ׳ (ed. Zuck. נמום, corr. acc.) what animal is called gamum? That which lacks horns, i.e. whose horns are not projecting, v. next w.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 1:8">Shebi. I, 8</cite> <he>אילן שנ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>שנפגם</he>) a tree which has been cut off (near the ground).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:4">Bekh. VI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 39a:9">39ᵃ</cite>) the incisors <he>שנפגמו ושנִגְמְמוּ</he> which are broken off or levelled (with the gum; cmp.

<cite ref="Chullin 70a:20">Ḥull. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>נגממו כותלי וכ׳</he> if the sides of the womb are peeled (diminished in size). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. l. c. <he>נגממו</he> after the leather bottles have grown too thin for holding liquids.

Kel. XVII, 4 נגממו if they are worn off (the sides of a vessel having become too thin), opp. נפרצו broken into (Maim.: the sides have been cut off, so that nothing but the bottom remained); Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 9 נפגמו ed. Zuck. (R. S. to Kel. l. c. נגממו).—Trnsf. to be degraded, disgraced.
Esth. R. to I, 9 (play on gam ib.) Vashti’s time has come לִיגָּמֵם to be disgraced (explained ליבצר).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> when a vineyard yields no fruits, <he>מְגַמְּמִין אותו</he> the owner cuts it down.
